$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

id.description: Declared contribution id. Effective id is authorId.packId.type.id at scan time.

author.description: Freeform credit for the contribution's creator. Independent of pack.json authorId (pack maintainer/distributor).

description.description: Short summary for lists/cards; keep longer notes in the pack README.

preview.description: Optional preview image path relative to the contribution directory. Raster only: png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif.

visualizer.description: Optional pin to a visualizer contribution. Layout size/chrome live in the layout tree + skin CSS; skins always render the full panel surface (the library Now Playing strip owns mini+expand).

id.description: Effective visualizer contribution id (authorId.packId.type.contributionId), or "global" to follow the user's active visualizer picker. Omit id (or this whole object) to use global.

stylesheet.description: Optional CSS file path relative to the skin pack root (e.g. skin.css). The runtime auto-prefixes every selector with [data-skin-id] for sandboxing — authors write plain selectors.

soundEffects.description: Optional UI sound assets keyed by logical id (paths under assets/ without extension; .wav on disk).

skinAssetFile.description: Pack-relative file path under assets/, including extension.

interactiveAssetsWhen.description: Bind path → asset set when truthy (last match wins).

presentation.description: How the runtime manages the native window for this view. Omit on a single-view skin (assumed primary). Skins with two or more views must set exactly one view to primary.

dragInference.description: Window drag inference. Runtime default: auto when layout.type is canvas, manual for row/column. Override per view.

onActivate.description: Effects run once when the skin-mode window becomes visible.

window.description: Native window size constraints for this view.

on.description: Named state transition events (e.g. toggle) mapped to ordered branch lists.

from.description: Current values that allow this branch (omit = any).

skinClickEffect.description: Click-handler step. Click wavs stay on the control (sound / soundWhen), not here.

when.description: Condition; effect runs only when truthy (same evaluator as visibleWhen).

payload.description: Merged into action payload (viewId, url, variable, event, …).

skinLifecycleEffect.description: View onActivate or GIF onComplete step. May play a sound with the action.

when.description: Condition; effect runs only when truthy (same evaluator as visibleWhen).

sound.description: Manifest soundEffects key played before the action.

viewLayout.description: View layout root. canvas = absolute bounds stage; row/column = flow flex tree. overlay, tiledFrame, and subview are children only.

type.description: canvas = absolute bounds stage; row/column = flow flex tree. overlay, tiledFrame, and subview are children only.

canvasRoot.description: Canvas view stage. width/height are the logical stage size; native window chrome stays on view.window.

dragRegion.description: When true, pointer events on this container move the skin window.

type.description: Horizontal flex container. Valid as a view layout root or as a nested child.

dragRegion.description: When true, pointer events on this container move the skin window.

type.description: Vertical flex container. Valid as a view layout root or as a nested child.

dragRegion.description: When true, pointer events on this container move the skin window.

layoutBounds.description: Fixed or stretch bounds against the current layout context (CSS edge insets). Default: x,y,w,h. Pin/stretch: omit w when x+right; omit h when y+bottom; omit x when right+w; omit y when bottom+h.

right.description: Inset of the node's right edge from the context right (CSS). With x and no w: horizontal stretch. With w and no x: right-anchored fixed width.

bottom.description: Inset of the node's bottom edge from the context bottom (CSS). With y and no h: vertical stretch. With h and no y: bottom-anchored fixed height.

skinCondition.description: Boolean composition of skin bind paths (leaf string or all/any/not).

nodeStyle.description: Closed, optional panel-writable paint. Numbers are px. Omitting a field cedes it to CSS.

backgroundColor.description: CSS color for the node fill.

className.description: Optional CSS class on the node root. Prefer id for one-off targeting.

type.description: Nested grouping container. Children overlay in place. Not valid as a view layout root.

dragRegion.description: When true, pointer events on this container move the skin window.

subviewNode.description: Bounded nested group (WMS subview). Parent-relative bounds; not valid as a view layout root.

passthrough.description: When true, the group bounds box does not capture pointer events (children still do).

dragRegion.description: When true, pointer events on empty group space move the skin window.
When true on a canvas view, marks a window drag handle

onClick.description: Ordered click effects. Omit sound here; use control sound / soundWhen.

enabledWhen.description: When truthy, the control is interactive.

activeWhen.description: When truthy, keep the pressed overlay (WMP sticky buttons).

sound.description: Manifest soundEffects key played on click.

soundWhen.description: Bind path → soundEffects key when truthy (last match wins).

tooltipWhen.description: Bind path → tooltip when truthy (last match wins).

textNode.description: Dynamic or static label. Omit presentation — there is no drawing backend to pick. Typography lives in style.

overflow.description: Runtime overflow behavior. Typography lives in style.

playlistNode.description: Track list with optional source dropdown and duration column. Feature flags live on the node; there is no presentation.

playingRowStyle.description: Panel-writable paint for the playing track row. Host applies it as inline style on __row--playing.

currentRowStyle.description: Panel-writable paint for the current track row. Host applies it as inline style on __row--current. When the row is also playing, playingRowStyle is merged on top.

showDropdown.description: Show source dropdown (All tracks, Up Next, user playlists). Default true.

showDuration.description: Show track duration column. Default true.

showArtwork.description: Show album artwork on each track row. Default false.

defaultSource.description: Initial playlist source. Default all. Runtime source still follows playlist.setSource after mount.

assetPattern.description: Asset path template under assets/ with extension; {deckIndex} and {page} placeholders.

showPageNav.description: When false, prev/next chrome is hidden (WMP trailer deck). Default true.

tooltipWhen.description: Bind path → tooltip when truthy (last match wins).
Bind path → tooltip when truthy (last match wins).

sound.description: Manifest soundEffects key played on any element click in this group.

elevateWhen.description: Sibling buttonGroup node ids. When any listed group is hovered or pressed, this group co-elevates above it so overlay artwork stays visible on overlapping composite sheets.

onClick.description: Ordered click effects. Omit sound here; use element sound / soundWhen.

activeWhen.description: When truthy, keep the pressed overlay (WMP sticky buttons).

enabledWhen.description: When truthy, the element is interactive.

sound.description: Manifest soundEffects key; overrides group-level sound.

soundWhen.description: Bind path → soundEffects key when truthy (last match wins).

tooltipWhen.description: Bind path → tooltip when truthy (last match wins).

durationMs.description: Target loop duration in ms; scales frame timing to match. With onComplete, fires after one scaled loop.

playbackRate.description: Multiplier on native frame delays (1 = file timing, 0.5 = half speed). Ignored when durationMs is set.

onComplete.description: Effects dispatched after the first scaled animation loop completes.

primitivePresentation.description: App chrome controls. For button nodes: optional icon/text/variant. Other node types ignore those fields.

icon.description: Button only. Library id (camelCase of Icon* export without Icon prefix, e.g. setList) or pack-relative asset under assets/.

variant.description: Button only. App Button variant, or plain for a chrome-less hit target (no hover fill). Default ghost.

direction.description: Fallback drag axis when positionMap is absent

valueFrames.description: How normalized value maps to strip frame indices. ascending (default): frame 0 = min value. descending: frame 0 = max value.

mapFrames.description: How position-map colors map to frame indices along the interaction axis. ascending (default): horizontal left / vertical bottom = frame 0.

track.description: Omitted for thumb-only sliders (groove baked into panel background).

trackTileWidth.description: Source tile width in px; required when track is set.

trackTileHeight.description: Source tile height in px; when less than trackHeight, 3-slice tiling repeats the middle.

borderSize.description: Cap size and thumb travel inset (WMP borderSize); enables 3-slice tiling when > 0

fillFromBottom.description: When true, the track image is a bottom-anchored value fill (WMP foregroundImage) revealed up to the current value; the empty groove is expected in the window background.

track.description: Omitted for thumb-only sliders (groove baked into panel background).

trackTileWidth.description: Source tile width in px; required when track is set. When less than trackWidth, 3-slice tiling repeats the middle.

trackTileHeight.description: Source tile height in px; required when track is set.

borderSize.description: Cap size and thumb travel inset (WMP borderSize); enables 3-slice tiling when > 0
Inset from each track edge for thumb travel (WMP borderSize)

signFrameElapsed.description: Strip frame for elapsed separator (WMP default 10)

signFrameRemaining.description: Strip frame for remaining prefix (WMP default 11)
